page_title: EMP 0-2 ACM | Empoli v AC Milan 08/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Luca Pairetto is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Empoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
89' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul.
88' Ismael Konate (Empoli) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
86' Mattia De Sciglio (Empoli) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan) will replace Joao Felix.
82' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alberto Grassi leaves the pitch and Jacopo Bacci (Empoli) comes on.
80' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ismael Konate (Empoli) replacing Sebastiano Esposito.
79' AC Milan hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
76' 0 - 2 Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the left post.
76' Kyle Walker (AC Milan) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Luca Pairetto signals.
75' Joao Felix (AC Milan) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar.
75' The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
73' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) makes a strong challenge and Luca Pairetto blows for a foul.
73' AC Milan take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
70' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to substitute Liam Henderson and he is replaced by Christian Kouame (Empoli).
70' Here comes a substitution. Lorenzo Colombo is given a rest as he is replaced by Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli).
69' The referee allows time for a substitution. Tijjani Reijnders will be replaced by Malick Thiaw (AC Milan).
68' 0 - 1 Rafael Leao (AC Milan) heads the ball low inside the left post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
65' The game is interrupted as Luca Marianucci (Empoli) is sent off by the referee.
65' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.

65' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Luca Marianucci (Empoli), but referee Luca Pairetto must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
63' Mike Maignan pulls off a great save to deny Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
62' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Alberto Grassi (Empoli).
61' AC Milan fail to score from a corner as Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach (Empoli) leaps to collect the ball.
60' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
58' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
55' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) is sent off after receiving a second yellow card from the referee!
54' The corner is swung in but AC Milan can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
52' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar.
51' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
49' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
48' Empoli keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Sergio Conceicao gives a chance to Santiago Tomas Gimenez and Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) is off.
46' The game is over for Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan). Rafael Leao comes on for the second half.
46' Sergio Conceicao prepares a substitution. Youssouf Fofana is replaced by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Fine attempt! Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
45+3' What was Liam Henderson (Empoli) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
41' AC Milan take a short corner kick.

41' Kyle Walker (AC Milan) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Luca Pairetto with no other option than to blow for a foul.
38' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
37' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AC Milan.
36' Yellow card. Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
35' A pass by Alberto Grassi (Empoli) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
34' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
33' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) receives a pass on the edge of the box and attempts a lob as the keeper is off his line, but the effort crashes off the left post.
32' AC Milan are seeing far more of the ball now.
28' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
28' Roberto D'Aversa is forced to make a change. Mattia Viti is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Saba Goglichidze (Empoli).
28' Mattia Viti (Empoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
27' The game is interrupted now, Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
25' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
25' AC Milan keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
23' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
21' Joao Felix (AC Milan) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
20' The ball is cleared after Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
18' Joao Felix (AC Milan) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
16' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
16' Empoli are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
15' Liam Henderson (Empoli) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
14' A pass by Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
12' Luca Pairetto interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alberto Grassi (Empoli).
11' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
11' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach.
10' Joao Felix (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
10' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Luca Pairetto decides there was no infringement by Liberato Cacace (Empoli) and the game can continue.

8' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Liberato Cacace (Empoli), but referee Luca Pairetto must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
8' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
6' A spell of possession for Empoli in an attempt to control the game.
5' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle and signals a foul after Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) brought his opponent down.
5' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' Liam Henderson (Empoli) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
3' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for AC Milan! Play can continue.
2' There's a break in play and referee Luca Pairetto must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by AC Milan using VAR. This could be interesting!
1' AC Milan players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Empoli will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Luca Pairetto.
